3946-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
3946-8344.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5708-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-5708-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-3899.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-864-997-3125-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-997-3125-5632.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-4772-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-4772-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4365-4772-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7782.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1003-2438-2626-4986.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-2511-4875.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2511-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

413-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Tower Winder trigger, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-7009-7068.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Spark Double
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Spark Double from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1399-1606-2957-7069.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and a land
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-5089-5315-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1414-3562.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1003-2981-5220-6900.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

539-5649-6517-6798.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

804-907-1479.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
2921-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2633-3368-4036.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Urabrask triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting Seething Song.
Urabrask triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve Reiterate, copying Seething Song and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1765-2287-3560-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1765-2287-3560-4050.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Chishiro and Archon of Sun's Grace trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit and a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {1}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

1109-1636-4050-5319.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Messenger does not have any +1/+1 counters.
1109-1636-4050-5319.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding one mana of any color.
Geralf's Messenger dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Messenger.
Repeat.

413-803-4242-4640.notablePrerequisites:
Oathkeeper attached to Su-Chi.
"Samurai" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
413-803-4242-4640.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1021-2440-4720-5321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Squirrel.
1021-2440-4720-5321.description:
Activate Squirrel Wrangler by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Drownyard Temple, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Both Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Squirrel on the battlefield.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.
